headlines.title: China’s factory-gate price growth picks up in August as Iran war fuels energy volatility
headlines.summary:
China’s factory-gate price growth accelerated in August, while consumer inflation picked up again, amid volatile energy and commodity costs linked to the US-Israel war on Iran.
The producer price index rose 3.8 per cent year on year last month, up from 3.5 per cent in July, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Wednesday.
The reading beat a 3.6 per cent projection from economists polled by financial data provider Wind.

headlines.summary_zh: 中国8月份工厂出厂价格增速加快，而消费者通胀再次抬头，原因在于与美以对伊朗战争相关的能源和大宗商品成本波动。国家统计局周三发布的数据显示，上月生产者价格指数同比上涨3.8%，高于7月份的3.5%。

headlines.title: Hong Kong stocks face double threat: US inflation and yen carry-trade risks

headlines.summary_en: Thursday (September 10) New York late trading: the ICE US Dollar Index rose 0.26% to 99.070, with an intraday range of 98.706-99.199, rising continuously since the European stock market open and hitting a new high since September 4 at 20:39 Beijing time (after the ECB announced a rate hike), moving away from the lowest level since August 21 of 98.599 set on Wednesday. headlines.title: 险资年内调研A股公司超万次，重点关注电子元件、工业机械、集成电路等硬科技领域个股
headlines.summary: Wind数据显示，今年以来，保险机构（保险公司和保险资管公司）合计调研A股上市公司10185次。从标的来看，险资主要关注电子元件、工业机械、集成电路等硬科技领域的个股。受访专家表示，硬科技领域符合国家战略导向、产业发展空间广阔、具备较大增长潜力、投资受监管鼓励，因此险资更有动力加大相关领域配置。（证券日报）

headlines.title_en: Insurers conducted over 10,000 research visits to A-share companies this year, focusing on hard-tech sectors such as electronic components, industrial machinery, and integrated circuits
headlines.summary_en: Wind data shows that since the start of this year, insurance institutions (insurance companies and insurance asset management companies) have conducted a total of 10,185 surveys of A-share listed companies. By target, insurance funds mainly focused on stocks in hard-tech sectors such as electronic components, industrial machinery, and integrated circuits. Interviewed experts said that the hard-tech sector aligns with national strategic direction, has broad industrial development space, significant growth potential, and is encouraged by regulation for investment, so insurance funds are more motivated to increase allocations to related sectors. (Securities Daily)
